prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: faithful historical Silent Storm softly PAINTED COLOR diffuse bitmap, not a photo.

Input1 is exact entire native original RGBA. Input2 is identical whole original storedRGB nearest-neighbor enlargement, source-only with no crops/patches. Refine this exact whole source bitmap with restrained fine painted detail only. Preserve full normalized UV, original pigment positions/phase/scale, broad soft blur, muted source palette, weak local relationships and every existing shape. The original complete alpha will be restored and brightness corrected by one scalar only.

Keep ONE original round iris and ONE dark pupil at their exact native source footprints. Preserve TWO tinted patches INSIDE the iris (upper native[29,24,36,29), lower[30,38,35,42)) and TWO broad pale washes OUTSIDE the iris (left[14,25,23,34), right[42,24,52,35)). The broad outside washes are original diffuse paint, not extra sharp catchlights. Keep all original gray-brown eyelid/sclera washes and the subtle dark lower brown shadow. No new anatomy, face, iris ring, radial fibers, veins, crystalline/mosaic cells, pores or new glossy reflections. Keep tinted patches soft/dim, not white shine.

Output ENTIRE square source canvas edge-to-edge with precisely the same normalized UV. No crop, BBox, fitting, zoom, padding, margins, transparent cutout, registration, artistic RGB repairs, new text/symbols/parts, weave/grain, photonoise or invented relief. Keep source relative brightness and soft edges; no locally strengthened white highlights.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Whole native storedRGBA to opaqueRGB NEAREST12x only, no crop/BBox/registration/padding/rotate/unpremultiply/sourceartRGB repair. Original fullA separately restored; ENTIRE raw inverse original4x/pure scalar/defaultpad.
